entry.title: 432 Player: Music in 432 Hz
entry.content:
优惠信息（价格：USD 5.99 → 免費 [免費 ~ USD 5.99]）

全部价格信息

价格：免費

App 內購買

  • Lifetime Membership：USD 81.99
  • Yearly Membership：USD 29.99
  • Monthly Membership：USD 4.29

应用描述

432 Player plays the music you already own, retuned live from A = 440 Hz to A = 432 Hz. Nothing is converted or copied in advance: press play and hear your own songs in 432. YOUR MUSIC, RETUNED AS IT PLAYS • 432 Hz, or 528 mode (A = 444 Hz), switched while the song is playing • Two ways to retune: Pitch shift keeps the song's speed; Song speed lowers pitch and tempo together, like a turntable • Hold Compare to hear the original tuning and decide for yourself • A test tone, so you can check the tuning with any tuner A REAL MUSIC PLAYER • Your Music library, the Files app, iCloud Drive and folders you link • MP3, AAC, M4A, FLAC, WAV, AIFF and more • 10-band equalizer with presets and your own settings • Playlists, Up Next, shuffle, repeat and search • Lyrics from the song file or a matching .lrc file, in time with the retuned song • Sleep timer, AirPlay, lock screen and headphone controls • Designed for iPhone and iPad INCLUDED: THE ALBUM DREAMWORLD Twelve tracks by Ophir Paz come with the app, so there is something to play from the first minute. You can hide the album in Settings if you want only your own music. FREE TO USE Every feature is included for free. Free listening gives you 18 minutes of 432 or 528 Hz at a time. Then the tuning rests for one hour, and your music keeps playing at its original pitch. 432 PLAYER PRO Pro removes the limit. One membership also unlocks 432 Player Radio, on iPhone and iPad. ALREADY BOUGHT 432 PLAYER? If you bought 432 Player before version 6, you keep full access for life. There is nothing you need to do. GOOD TO KNOW • Songs from an Apple Music subscription are protected and can't be retuned. Songs you own, bought or imported, play in 432. • Most recorded music is tuned to A = 440 Hz, and that is what the app assumes. • No account and no sign-in. Your music stays on your device. PRIVACY The app collects anonymous usage data and crash reports to help improve it. They are never linked to you and never used for advertising, and you can switch them off in Settings. SUBSCRIPTIONS 432 Player Pro is offered as a monthly or a yearly subscription, and to new listeners as a one-time lifetime purchase for a limited time. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://432player.com/privacy/

应用描述

Play the ultimate digital version of the multi-award-winning modern classic board game Ticket to Ride! Journey across various countries, connecting their vibrant cities and exploring their unique gameplay mechanics and bonuses on the way. Ticket to Ride offers a variety of game modes to suit you. Want to get competitive? Head online to challenge other players around the world and climb the leaderboards, or play with friends further afield in a private game. Got a packed schedule? Set up or join an asynchronous game and play across multiple days – we’ll notify you when it is your turn, so you can go at your own pace. Test out new strategies or keep it casual in single-player mode against state-of-the-art AI opponents. You can even make a game night of it with friends and family in couch play! Get to know a cast of unforgettable characters, each bringing their own tales to the table. Add new locomotives and carriages to your fleet with every expansion, and cement your name in railway history on the leaderboard! Become a railway legend in the iconic, fan-favourite modern classic! HOW TO PLAY TICKET TO RIDE®: Players are dealt a number of tickets and must pick a certain number to keep (depending on the map). Players are also dealt four train cards of various colours. This number can also vary depending on the map you’re playing on, but don’t worry – the AI takes care of this! Each turn, players can draw two train cards from the face-up pile, draw two train cards from the face-down pile, draw another ticket to complete, or use their train cards to claim a route! A claimed route is shown by placing train pieces along the route. When a player has three or fewer train pieces left, the last round starts. Whoever has the most points at the end of the game is the winner! FEATURES A TRULY SOCIAL TAKE ON MULTIPLAYER – Play online with friends or enjoy a seamless matchmaking experience when you challenge players from around the world. Alternatively, take on your friend sitting right next to you in couch play – use the free Ticket to Ride Companion App to really boost your couch gaming session! PLAY AROUND YOUR BUSY DAY – Set up a game in async mode and play a game across multiple days. SINGLE-PLAYER MODE DRIVEN BY EXPERT AIs – Powered by an innovative adaptive AI system, single-player mode offers a challenge for new and experienced players alike. AN IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE – Every moment has been brought to life with beautiful graphics that will immerse you in the adventure. STRATEGIC GAMEPLAY – Every game presents fresh challenges, and it’s your mission to work out the most efficient solutions. Collect points by completing tickets, linking destinations and building the longest route. Join the Marmalade Game Studio Discord server to connect with players, organise matches, see the latest news and updates, and take part in events!

entry.content:
优惠信息（价格：USD 4.99 → USD 1.79 [USD 1.79 ~ USD 4.99]）

全部价格信息

价格：USD 1.79

应用描述

Film Light，做你口袋里的专业数字测光表！适用于胶片摄影、影视灯光。 基于场景参考(Scene-Referred)的专业摄影测光表 APP。基于 Apple Log 色彩管线，高效测光，精准预览。独创的拟物风拨盘测光 UI，可快速进行光圈优先，快门优先以及手动曝光预览模式切换。内置经典胶片模拟LUT，亦可自定义导入 .cube 文件。支持近 1 度精准点测、智能矩阵测光。便捷的曝光补偿、ND 滤镜计算。 独创的测距功能，依靠LiDAR硬件，实时计算并预览你的景深范围。具备深度俯视图、深度伪色功能。估焦相机再也不用靠猜了！ 不止是测光表，更是你的摄影日志。内置相册功能，支持项目与胶卷管理；相册可查看 EV 点表、随时切换 LUT 预览，让每一次曝光决策都留有记录。 机型要求： iPhone 15 Pro 及后续支持 Apple Log 的机型可获得完整体验。在不支持 Apple Log 的机型上，Film Light 将以 HLG 模式运行；由于该模式下的画面经过局部影调映射（LTM），任意移动取样点后的读数无法保证准确，因此自定义 EV 点表结果并不准确。 测距功能需要使用搭载 LiDAR 硬件的 iPhone，需要 iPhone 12 Pro/Pro Max 以上的 Pro/Pro Max机型。
